pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with high-contrast, jagged edge gradients. The geometry transitions from larger, more stable quadrilaterals on the lower neck to increasingly elongated and irregular shapes along the flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent or tetra-valent. Corridor thickness is variable, exhibiting localized narrowing at junction points and widening along the transverse axes of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper neck as a short, dense, and continuous vertical protrusion. The 1D silhouette shows low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness against the background luminance.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, linear, light-colored diagonal mark is visible on the upper hindquarter/rump, bisecting a dark patch and indicating a localized loss of pigment or scarring.
